description.fun: The swirl on Poliwag's belly is its insides showing through its thin skin, and the direction it turns is said to depend on which side of the equator it lives. Its new legs are poor at walking, but it loves to waddle around on land, darting back into the water at the first sign of danger. It's the favourite Pokémon of Satoshi Tajiri, the creator of Pokémon.
description.guide: A round, blue tadpole Pokémon, Water type, with a swirl on its belly formed by its organs showing through its thin skin. It swims well but is clumsy on land. It evolves into Poliwhirl.
description.tagline: A tadpole with its insides on show

description.fun: Staring at the slowly turning swirl on Poliwhirl's belly makes you drowsy, and it's even used to send children to sleep. Out of water, Poliwhirl sweats an oily slime that lets it slip out of an enemy's grasp. It was the logo of the Pokémon Center in Tokyo until Piplup took over in 2007.
description.guide: The middle stage of Poliwag's line, a round, blue Water Pokémon with a hypnotic swirl on its belly. It keeps its skin moist with an oily sweat that helps it slip away from enemies. It evolves into Poliwrath with a Water Stone or into Politoed when traded holding a King's Rock.
description.tagline: Stare at the swirl and you'll start to yawn

branches.text: Poliwhirl has two futures. A Water Stone turns it into Poliwrath, a muscular Water and Fighting swimmer that keeps its tadpole look; trading it while it holds a King's Rock turns it into Politoed, a frog king added in Generation 2.

description.fun: Poliwrath is almost all muscle, with no body fat at all, and its arms and legs never tire. It can swim vast distances barely taking a breath, outswim world-class swimmers, briefly run across water and smash through ice, and its punches grind boulders to dust. Many children learn to swim by copying its stroke.
description.guide: One of Poliwag's two final forms, evolving from Poliwhirl with a Water Stone. It is a Water and Fighting Pokémon with powerful muscles that make it a tireless swimmer and a strong martial artist.
description.tagline: A tadpole bodybuilder that swims like an Olympian

description.fun: The curl on Politoed's head is the mark of a king: the longer and curlier it is, the more Poliwag and Poliwhirl obey it, and they come from far away when it calls. When three or more Politoed gather, they sing together in a booming chorus. Fittingly, it evolves holding a King's Rock, perhaps a nod to the Frog Prince story.
description.guide: One of Poliwag's two final forms, introduced in Generation 2, which evolves when Poliwhirl is traded holding a King's Rock. It is a green, frog-like Water Pokémon that leads groups of Poliwag and Poliwhirl and likes to sing.
description.tagline: A frog king whose curl commands the pond
